async def act(page):
    # Get all link elements on the page using get_by_role
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    # Get the count of links
    count = await all_links.count()
    # Initialize a list to store text content
    links_text_list = []
    # Iterate through each link and get its text content without processing
    for i in range(count):
        link_text = await all_links.nth(i).text_content()
        links_text_list.append(link_text)
    # Join all text contents with newlines
    all_links_text = '\n'.join(links_text_list)
    return all_links_text
